candidates.explanation: The refresh token is signed with expiresIn read from 'auth.expires' (the short access-token lifetime) instead of 'auth.refreshExpires' (AUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRES_IN). The refresh token therefore expires just minutes after it is issued, and /auth/refresh returns 401 once the access-token lifetime has passed. The 30d setting is never used.

fix.description: Use the refresh expiry config when signing the refresh token: change getOrThrow('auth.expires') to getOrThrow('auth.refreshExpires', { infer: true }) at lines 632-634.
